decisions.reason: As a new flagship automation module that fits the firm's integrated, future-ready precast plant strategy, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is likely to be retained.
The automatic de-shuttering robot extends the established product range and can still serve customers needing a modular or lower-investment solution than a combined system.
The profile storage robot supports plant automation and workflow efficiency, so despite being somewhat more specialized it still fits the firm's broad system-solution offering.
The automatic shuttering robot complements both standalone and integrated plant configurations, making it likely to remain in the portfolio alongside other automation options.
